JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then shall we stop for today?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 今日はここまでにしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Alors, est-ce que ça va revenir aujourd'hui ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Warum bin ich heute so verwirrt?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: แล้ววันนี้จะกลับมาได้ไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy là hôm nay lại quay về sao?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 딱 한 번만 다시 해보면 어때?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: How about trying just one more time?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: もう一度だけやってみないか？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Was, wenn wir es einfach noch einmal versuchen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¿Qué tal si lo intentamos de nuevo?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Só mais uma vez, que tal?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ลองทำอีกครั้งสิ แล้วจะเป็นยังไง?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Thử lại một lần nữa thì sao nhỉ?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ta sẽ cho ngươi một viên thuốc hồi sức.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I decided to call it a day and head back with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 今日は<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と共に戻ることにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé de rentrer aujourd'hui avec lui.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> วันนี้เราจะกลับไปด้วยกัน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hari ini akan kembali bersama dengan dia.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định quay về hôm nay.

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はどこか心残りがあるようだった。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble avoir un sentiment de regret.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะยังไม่เข้าใจ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thật đáng thương, ta không biết gì cả.

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versucht es erneut und ist erfolgreich.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองท้าทายอีกครั้งและจะพบกับชัยชนะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại thử thách và đã thành công.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gave the training another try, but couldn't complete it.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度挑戦したが、力及ばなかった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>虽然再次挑战，但还是太勉强了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>雖然再次挑戰，但還是太勉強了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> essaie à nouveau, mais c'est inutile.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versucht es erneut, aber es war nutzlos.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vuelve a intentarlo, pero es demasiado difícil.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Tentou novamente, mas foi em vão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองท้าทายอีกครั้ง แต่ก็สายไปแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại thử thách nhưng đã thất bại.

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は活力ポーションのおかげで元気を取り戻した。

Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>託活力藥水的福，重新找回了元氣。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a trouvé la force dans la Potion de Guérison.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat dank der Vitalitätspotion neue Energie gewonnen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperó su energía gracias a la poción de vitalidad.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperou a força devido ao elixir de vitalidade.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เติมพลังด้วยโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menemukan kembali energi berkat minum elixir kehidupan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hồi phục sức lực nhờ viên thuốc hồi sức.
